opening_message:
Ticket 1: Diana Cooper (employee ID E020) requests admin access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E020.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: admin
  - comment: Diana Cooper (E020) is a full-time Engineer requesting admin access to Source Code. Since Engineers own Source Code, full-time employees in the owning role may have admin. Recommend granting admin.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - role: Engineer
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB shows Diana Cooper (E020) is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors never exceed read without advanced training. Requested admin is above the maximum, so grant read.
reason: There is conflicting information about Diana Cooper's (E020) employment type: HR lists her as full-time, but the Security DB lists her as a contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractors with only basic training may never exceed read access, and admin is never allowed for contractors. Since the requested level (admin) is above the contractor maximum, the granted level is capped at read. The Security agent's recommendation of read is followed.
